name: Question 4
problem:
Consider the following system of differential equations:

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=Ax(t)+f(t)
$$

Using the method of variation of parameters, we wish to find a particular solution in the form ${x}_{p}(t)=Φu(t),$ where $Φ$ is a fundamental matrix for the corresponding homogeneous system and $u(t)$ is a column vector of functions to be determined. A derivation of the formula for ${x}_{p}(t)$ is given below. 

$\text{L1}:\,$ ${x}_{p}(t)=Φu(t)$

$\text{L2}:\,$ ${x}_{p}^{′}(t)=Φ{u}^{′}(t)+{Φ}^{′}u(t)$

$\text{L3}:\,$ $Φ{u}^{′}(t)+{Φ}^{′}u(t)=AΦu(t)+f(t)$

$\text{L4}:\,$ ${Φ}^{′}=AΦ$

$\text{L5}:\,$ $Φ{u}^{′}(t)=f(t)$

$\text{L6}:\,$ ${u}^{′}(t)={Φ}^{-1}(t)f(t)$

$\text{L7}:\,$ $u(t)=\int {Φ}^{-1}f(t)\,\text{d}t$

$\text{L8}:\,$ ${x}_{p}(t)=Φ\int {Φ}^{-1}f(t)\,\text{d}t$

Select the correct options in the following reasoning.

$\,$ Line $\text{L2}$ follows from line $\text{L1}$ by {{field-1}} both sides of  the equation.

$\,$ Line $\text{L3}$ is obtained by substituting $\text{L1}$ and $\text{L2}$ into the {{field-2}}.

$\,$ Line $\text{L6}$ follows from line $\text{L5}$ by {{field-3}} both sides of the equation.

$\,$ Line $\text{L7}$ follows from line $\text{L6}$ by {{field-4}} both sides of the equation.

Consider the following system of differential equations: x′(t)=Ax(t)+f(t) Using the method of variation of parameters, we wish to find a particular solution in the form xp(t)=Φu(t), where Φ is a fundamental matrix for the corresponding homogeneous system and u(t) is a column vector of functions to be determined. A derivation of the formula for xp(t) is given below.

L1: xp(t)=Φu(t)

L2: xp′(t)=Φu′(t)+Φ′u(t)

L3: Φu′(t)+Φ′u(t)=AΦu(t)+f(t)

L4: Φ′=AΦ

L5: Φu′(t)=f(t)

L6: u′(t)=Φ−1(t)f(t)

L7: u(t)=∫Φ−1f(t)dt

L8: xp(t)=Φ∫Φ−1f(t)dt

Select the correct options in the following reasoning.

both sides of the equation.

Line L3 is obtained by substituting L1 and L2 into the
 
initial system of ODEs
